FN-BDI2JQ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 441
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/16/2023
House Bill 441 as introduced could increase receipts to (1) the State General Fund, credited to
the Office of the Attorney General, and (2) the Special Mental Health Trust Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent on the amount of registration and licensing fees for the
publication or access to certain material that is harmful to minors, as provided by this bill, which
fees shall be established by rule of, and collected by, the Consumer Protection Division of the
Office of the Attorney General, to be deposited equally to the funds above.
This bill would also provide for the collection of civil penalties, up to $2,000 for each violation,
and the collection of reasonable attorneys fees and costs by the Attorney General.
Page 1
